Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiment specifically compares proteins recruited to the cell cortex at the contact site of Wnt3a-immobilized beads versus BSA-immobilized beads in metaphase HeLa cells. While Wnt3a is a growth factor/signaling ligand, it is mapped to the ligand_stimulation category. The specific child class 'immune_receptor_ligand_stimulation' is used as a proxy for receptor-ligand engagement in this context, though Wnt3a is technically a developmental signaling ligand.
